basic_details.job_title: TIFT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Sector Expert, Senior Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government of Tripura, Tripura Institution for Transformation (TIFT) has announced 5 contract vacancies for Senior Program Manager (State Innovation Mission – Tripura), Senior Associate – Operations (State Innovation Mission – Tripura), Sector Expert – Technology & Entrepreneurship, Sector Expert – Industry & Trade, and Sector Expert – Economics & Finance posts. Qualification and eligibility requirements vary according to the post, with the engagement offered on a contract basis for an initial tenure of 11 (eleven) months. Candidates can apply online from 16 October 2026 to 7 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Tripura Institution for Transformation (TIFT) has released a total of 5 contractual vacancies across five specific roles. The post-wise breakdown is provided below:

rows.position: Senior Program Manager (State Innovation Mission – Tripura)
Senior Associate – Operations (State Innovation Mission – Tripura)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ for each position under the Tripura Institution for Transformation recruitment: Senior Program Manager (State Innovation Mission – Tripura): Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university or institution with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Desirable qualifications include a postgraduate degree in Management, Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Public Policy, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Candidates must have a minimum of 8 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in startup incubation, innovation, or entrepreneurship development, and/or as a founder or co-founder actively involved in building and managing a startup or enterprise. Senior Associate – Operations (State Innovation Mission – Tripura): Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university or institution with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Desirable qualifications include a postgraduate qualification in Management, Business Administration, Operations, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, or Public Administration. Requires a minimum of 8 years of professional experience in operations management, programme or project coordination, or administration in an incubator, accelerator, startup, university, engineering college, government agency, or development organisation. Sector Expert – Technology & Entrepreneurship: Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, MBA with specialisation in Technology Management or Innovation, or Post Graduate Diploma in Management with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Requires minimum 8 years of experience relevant to the job description, preferably in technology policy, startup ecosystem development, innovation management, digital governance, e-governance initiatives, technology transfer, and incubation or acceleration programmes. Candidates must be below 45 years of age. Sector Expert – Industry & Trade: Masters in Economics, Commerce, Business Administration, Industrial Policy, MBA with specialisation in Industrial Management or International Trade, or Post Graduate Diploma in Management with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Requires minimum 8 years of experience relevant to the job description, with preference for work experience in industrial policy, MSME development, trade promotion, investment facilitation, ease of doing business reforms, and industrial corridor development. Candidates must be below 45 years of age. Sector Expert – Economics & Finance: Masters in Economics, Finance, Public Policy, MBA in Finance, or Post Graduate Diploma in Management with specialisation in Finance or Economics with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Requires minimum 8 years of experience relevant to the job description, with preference given to work experience in economic policy, public finance management, fiscal analysis, budgetary planning, economic modelling, investment analysis, and deve

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All positions carry a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 1,00,000/- inclusive of all. The initial tenure of engagement is 11 (eleven) months, which is renewable for further periods subject to satisfactory performance, continuing institutional requirements, and approval from the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: TIFT Senior Program Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged professionals will manage various responsibilities under the State Innovation Mission – Tripura and sector expert domains: Plan and execute end-to-end incubation, acceleration, and innovation programme cycles, including outreach, application, screening, selection, and onboarding. Translate Mission priorities into programme plans, calendars, milestones, and measurable outcome indicators. Serve as the principal day-to-day contact for participating innovators, founders, and startups; connect them with mentors, experts, investors, and ecosystem partners. Maintain synergy between the State Planning Department/TIFT, LKI, and NITI Aayog. Evaluate and assess existing strategies, methodologies, and systems to improve sectoral ecosystems in Tripura. Prepare development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals, and State Vision@2047 as per the State's requirements. Support procurement, vendor coordination, travel, venue, hospitality, and administrative arrangements in accordance with applicable Government procedures.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TIFT Senior Program Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruitment.tift.org.in/ to access the online application form. Complete the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and professional details starting from 16 October 2026. Submit the application online on or before 07 November 2026 till 6:00 PM. In case of technical issues during application submission, attach a screenshot of the issue and email it to [email protected] for assistance.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection method is conducted through an open market contractual engagement process based on eligibility criteria, professional experience, and qualifications evaluated by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is TIFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TIFT Recruitment 2026 is a contractual engagement notification issued by the Tripura Institution for Transformation, Government of Tripura, to fill 5 positions including Senior Program Manager, Senior Associate, and Sector Experts under the State Innovation Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available across five different contractual posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TIFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 07 November 2026 till 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Program Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university or institution with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate, along with 8 years of professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Sector Expert positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Sector Expert positions must be below 45 years of age as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration offered for these posts?
faq.answer: All 5 contractual positions carry a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for TIFT contractual vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website at https://recruitment.tift.org.in/ between 16 October 2026 and 07 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these positions are temporary contractual, consultant, or project-linked engagements for an initial tenure of 11 months, renewable based on performance and institutional requirements, and do not confer any right to regular appointments.

faq.question: Q9. What should I do if I face technical issues while submitting the application?
faq.answer: In case of technical issues, candidates should take a screenshot of the issue and email it directly to [email protected].
